reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

The answer comes from this incident channel. On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She closed the incident at 18:43 that day, once labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I told him I couldn't find a street address or any other site details for Southgate in the channels and files he can see. I only checked channels he belongs to and public files. There is no Tansley Parcel account folder in the share.
